title: so far, perfect
text:
so far, perfect. I got so very tired of replacing a toaster every year. So, I decided to step up to toaster oven and this one is, in a word, perfect. At least for me. It's small, but able to do big things. I placed my 4 quart corning ware casserole and it baked perfectly. Toast is a breeze with super easy adjustments. I like my toast dark and crisp. I like that is takes a little more space on my counter than the toaster, but it does SO much more. Another thing, it preheats SUPER fast.
I researched a bunch of different brands and I have to say that I am very happy with my choice. I will post updates as time goes by.

10/16/2013 UPDATE: Wow. I am SO in love with this toaster oven. The more I use it, the more I love it. I love the "little bit more" button... perfect for toast. Different kinds of bread need different times. I've baked in it with perfect results. I use it several times a week. Still love love it! I wish I would have purchased it several regular toasters ago.

3/9/2014 UPDATE: STILL in love. I hope it lasts for a really long time because frankly I can't live without it. If you are just one person or maybe two you REALLY need this toaster oven!

product_metadata.title: Breville BOV450XL Remanufactured the Mini Smart Oven
features: Electronic elements move the heat where and when it's needed to suit whatever you're cooking
Timer with auto shut-off and alert
description: The mini oven that moves heat where and when it's needed. Cozy counters need love, too. Following the success of the Smart Oven and the Compact Smart Oven, this mini oven neatly fits even smaller kitchens - but can do many of the cooking tasks of a conventional wall oven. Introducing the Mini Smart Oven with Element IQ, the little oven that thinks big.
